scope: Static instructions and fixed constant only; no execution of the full UI, PM table reader, setter or hardware.
observations: Shimada/GPT/Granite fused-CCD helper path uses a native-thread-count helper, not the older fuse registers.
Native-thread-count helper requests CPUID leaf 1 and extracts output EBX bits 23:16 without checking wrapper status.
PM vector column selection is this+f8c; first column length supplies the iteration count.
Each admitted PM table index i becomes CCD=i/8, core=i%8; a length above 16 admits every row irrespective of the floating-point threshold.
These instructions do not establish firmware-to-physical-core mapping or correctness of the PM table layout.
The UI curve setter routes to AMD_PM_LOG all/per-core methods; the same-name AMD_PBO setter is a distinct F8/FC sequence, not the B8/BC query.
